# S57 — TUI keys: up/down move rows, tab and left/right move projects

Owner 2026-10-20: in the TUI the cursor only moves between projects; Enter does nothing and the stopped S21 and S29 rows cannot be reached, because rows are moved with n and p while up, down, j, k and tab move projects (internal/tui/keys.go:35-36). Decided #112 (ui.row-keys): up, down, j and k move rows; tab, shift+tab, left, right and 1-9 move projects; n and p keep moving rows.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Rows are what the owner acts on (open a pane, approve, stop, retry), so they need the natural list keys. The row keys were not discoverable.

- internal/tui: keys.go (Next and Prev lose up, down, j and k; RowNext and RowPrev gain them; update the help text of the four bindings), model.go (key dispatch at the Next, Prev, RowNext and RowPrev cases), the help view, tests, the two action-help goldens (testdata/golden/action-help-mono-true.txt and -false.txt; regenerate with go test ./internal/tui -update and review the diff) and any golden that lists keys.
- Existing tests that use j, k, up or down to change project and must move to tab, shift+tab, left or right: internal/tui/sidebar_test.go (TestSidebarNavigationFilterAndHide, the 15-project scroll test near line 97, TestSidebarArrowNavigation, the filter-retention test near line 204) and internal/tui/tui_test.go (the j and k steps near lines 593 and 597).
